title: Workflow (parallix) optional override config
description: Optional per-repository override for the workflow runtime. The tool ships code-owned defaults and runs with no config file; create workflow.config.json only to override a default. Every section and field is optional and is merged over the built-in defaults. Run `px config` to print the effective configuration.

integration.description: Repository integration authority. Omit the section to keep the default local mode, in which Parallix owns the merge into the primary branch.

mode.description: local: Parallix integrates into the configured primary branch (default, GitHub-unaware). github-publish: Parallix integrates locally and GitHub independently verifies the exact resulting commit before it publishes to the protected primary branch. github-pr: Parallix pushes a reviewable mission branch and GitHub/PR policy owns the final merge. Any other value is a configuration error.

tasks.description: Task tracker and on-disk task storage.

provider.description: Task tracker provider. backlog-md is the only supported value; any other value is rejected.

stateMap.description: Repo-relative path to the virtual-to-actual Backlog state map.

storage.description: Task storage directory (string) or an object with tasksDir/completedDir.

missions.description: Mission document layout and branch/worktree conventions.

branchPrefix.description: Branch name prefix for missions, e.g. mission/.

primaryBranch.description: Primary branch override if not auto-detected.

gates.description: Ordered, per-phase lifecycle gate commands. Disabled by default: omit this section (or a phase key) to run no lifecycle gate for that phase. Each phase is an ordered array of gate objects; the array order is the execution order. A gate object has a required string `key`, a required string `command` (a runnable shell command, no trailing prose), and an optional numeric `order` (default 0, ascending). Each configured command runs in the phase checkout and receives PARALLIX_MISSION_SLUG, PARALLIX_CHECKOUT_PATH, and PARALLIX_PHASE in its environment; a non-zero exit blocks that phase's state transition or merge.

requirePreIntegration.description: When true, the integration merge boundary fails closed if no adapters.gates.preIntegration gates are configured. Defaults to false so an unconfigured repository completes the integration path with no lifecycle gate (mission task-2457 success criterion 1). Set true in a repository that wants the TASK-2300 mandatory-gate invariant.

preHandoff.description: Ordered gates run before the handoff (active -> review) transition.

key.description: Stable identifier for the gate, used in logs and failure reports.

command.description: Exact runnable shell command. No trailing prose or outcome language.

order.description: Sort key; gates run in ascending order. Defaults to 0.

preReview.description: Ordered gates run before the review phase (reviewer actions and the review -> integration approval).

preIntegration.description: Ordered gates run before the integration merge (review -> integration approval path and the merge boundary).

githubPublish.description: Optional github-publish mode. Opt-in publication engine that publishes the exact locally-generated integration commit unchanged to a per-commit verification ref and advances origin/main only through the highest contiguous run of externally verified commits. Additive to the squash-merge integration path; unset keeps today's default behavior byte for byte.

enabled.description: Enable github-publish mode. When false or unset, the default squash-merge integration path runs unchanged and the publication engine is never invoked.

mainBranch.description: Protected main branch the publication engine advances via fast-forward. Defaults to the repository's primary branch.

verificationRemote.description: Git remote the exact integration commit is pushed to for external verification. Defaults to 'origin'.

verificationRefPrefix.description: Ref path prefix under refs/ for the per-commit verification ref. Encodes the commit SHA, so each ref is unique. Defaults to 'github-publish'.

pollIntervalMs.description: Base interval between verification polls in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.

maxPollAttempts.description: Maximum verification polls before giving up. null means poll indefinitely while GitHub is pending. Defaults to null.

integrate.description: Optional post-integrate hook. When postIntegrateCommand is unset, `px integrate` behaves exactly as it does without this section.

postIntegrateCommand.description: Shell command run at most once, from the base checkout, after a successful non-dry-run `px integrate`. Receives INTEGRATE_HOOK_SLUG, INTEGRATE_HOOK_BASE_WORKTREE, INTEGRATE_HOOK_BASE_BRANCH, and INTEGRATE_HOOK_VARIANT as environment variables.

review.description: Review surface. An unset provider keeps the lifecycle running without a mirrored review provider; set provider to 'forgejo' (with baseUrl, remote, repo) to enable Forgejo, or 'none' to run without one.

agents.description: Agent adapter settings. Agent launcher commands are resolved from PATH and configured via operator-local environment, not this file.

maxConcurrentCustom.description: Optional maximum simultaneously running custom-agent instances. When unset, custom-agent launches are unlimited; configured values must be positive integers.

models.description: Optional per-agent-family LLM model override, keyed by agent family name (e.g. codex, claude, gemini, glm, vibe, custom). Each value is the model identifier passed to that agent's CLI. A family that is not listed sends no model parameter, so the agent uses its own default. There is no 'default' key.

runners.description: Runner selection for agent families that support multiple backends. Currently only 'custom' is supported, with values 'opencode' or 'pi'.

custom.description: Selects the launcher backend for the custom agent family. Defaults to 'opencode' if not specified.

subagents.description: Operational limits for subagent spawning within an agent.

maxParallel.description: Maximum number of parallel subagent forks. When unset, null, or zero, no limit is applied.

prompts.description: Prompt split configuration. Closed object with a single allowed property, override. Selects one repo-local default-opinion file to assemble in place of the shipped default-opinion half; unset keeps today's prompts byte for byte.

override.description: Repo-relative or absolute path to a repo-local default-opinion file. Parallix always assembles the mandatory core half; only the opinion half is replaced. Unknown keys beneath adapters.prompts are rejected.
